title: Asking for Directions
summary: Diálogo en la calle — preposiciones de lugar, imperativos, números.
script:
Tourist: Excuse me. Is there a pharmacy near here?
Local: Yes, there's one on Green Street. It's very close.
Tourist: How do I get there?
Local: Go straight for two blocks, then turn left at the bank.
Tourist: Turn left at the bank. And then?
Local: The pharmacy is on your right, next to a small bakery.
Tourist: Is it open now?
Local: I think so. It closes at eight.
Tourist: Thank you very much!
Local: You're welcome. Have a good day.

questions.q: What is the tourist looking for?
How many blocks must they walk?
What is next to the pharmacy?
